text: The Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil records that Lopez Rubio Grand Class SL became a single-member company with UPCYCLING HOLDING SL as its sole shareholder (socio único), registered on 14 November 2024. UPCYCLING HOLDING SL's sole administrator since 3 March 2022 is Pedro Miguel Lopez Rubio.
short: UPCYCLING HOLDING SL is the sole shareholder of Lopez Rubio Grand Class SL (BORME, November 2024).

source.name: BOE: Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil, BORME-A-2024-225-28 (Madrid)
